candidates.rationale: Newer than the registered file and its service dates do run into 2027, but the archive is malformed and no calendar can be read from it: the date fields carry stray carriage returns, so end_date fails to parse. It also contains a copy of the older feed nested inside, and is named as a forwarded email attachment, which together suggest a file was mailed in and published verbatim. Not registered while the calendar is unreadable, though the underlying data is current and the agency could fix this.
